A full-body chibi-style fantasy merchant character stands centered against a clean pure white background, occupying most of the canvas vertically with generous empty space around her. She is depicted as a young adult woman with a petite, rounded 2D-anime body proportion, approximately two-heads tall, facing forward with her head turned slightly toward the viewer’s right. Her expression is sly, confident, and warmly calculating: large brown eyes with bright highlights, long lashes, softly arched brows, rosy cheeks, a small nose, and a subtle closed-mouth smile. Her skin is fair and smoothly shaded, with delicate blush and polished anime-style facial rendering. She has dark brown to black hair styled in a voluminous half-up arrangement, with loose strands framing her face, a high gathered bun or ponytail section, and long flowing locks cascading over her shoulders and down her back. The hair is glossy, finely drawn, and accented by ornate gold hairpins, floral metal ornaments, dangling chains, beads, and red gemstone drops.

She wears an elaborate red-and-gold merchant outfit inspired by East Asian fantasy fashion. The main garment is a fitted deep crimson brocade dress or robe with gold floral and vine embroidery, a wrap-style neckline, and layered skirt panels. Over it is a plush cream-white fur vest or stole with dense, fluffy texture, wrapping around her shoulders and arms like a luxury merchant’s cloak. The sleeves and cuffs include black and gold trim, giving the outfit a richly layered, expensive appearance. Around her waist is a structured belt with gold hardware, decorative clasps, chains, tassels, coin-like pendants, and a central ornament, emphasizing her wealthy merchant status. She wears dark brown boots with gold embroidery and ornamental patterns, visible beneath the layered hem of the robe. Gold earrings with red gemstones hang beside her face, matching the hair ornaments and accessories.

Her left hand, positioned on the viewer’s left side of the image, holds an open ledger book angled outward. The book has tan-brown covers, thick cream pages, visible ruled lines, and faint handwritten marks or accounting strokes on the page surface. Her right hand, on the viewer’s right side, holds a decorative golden key upright; the key has an ornate bow and long shaft, visually signaling trade, access, or valuable goods. Hanging near her chest and belt are additional merchant-related accessories, including a rectangular wooden or bronze-toned toothed tag suspended by a chain, a small wooden cargo box with metal fittings and a handle, a gold balance-scale charm with tiny hanging pans, and multiple gold chains, beads, tassels, and coin ornaments. These props cluster naturally around her torso and hip, reinforcing the role of a traveling merchant or pawnshop owner.

The composition is a polished digital illustration with crisp linework, soft cel-shaded gradients, and highly detailed material rendering. The lighting is bright and even, coming from the upper left, creating gentle highlights on the satin-like red fabric, metallic gold ornaments, gemstones, fur, and boots. The color palette is dominated by crimson red, warm gold, cream white, dark brown, and black accents. The overall mood is charming, prosperous, and clever, presenting the character as a refined female merchant with a shrewd businesslike personality. The image has no environmental setting beyond the plain white background, keeping all attention on the character design, costume details, and fantasy-accessory styling.

你是面向文生图模型的专业提示词工程师。
你的任务是把用户提供的【角色名】与【描述】，扩写成高效的图像生成**中文**提示词。在撰写答案前，按以下步骤思考：
主体与氛围是什么？
风格： chibi-style ，动漫风格奇幻角色设计
适合哪些视觉风格、绘画媒介与光影方案？思考两到三个备选方案，挑选最贴合描述的一种。
什么样的构图、取景与落地细节，能帮助文生图模型稳定出图？随后输出一段完整扩写后的提示词段落。严格遵守以下规则：
优先忠于原意：严格依据用户给到的角色名与角色描述，保留全部原有角色形象、神态、服饰配色、人物姿态与空间关系。除非用户明确提及，不额外新增物体、道具、动物。
实用文生图结构：写出模型易于识别解析的提示词。把人物主体和对应的属性、动作必需是站立，对神态、画面空间布局使用明确具象的描述，没有背景。
风格规划仅在内部思考：内部完成风格取舍，最终只输出扩写完成的提示词，不在最终结果中展示思考过程。
配套固定美术设定：2头身，Q版中式武侠角色，完整全身立绘，从头到脚完整显示在画布内，头部高度等于全身总高度的1/2，严格固定人体比例，躯干短，四肢短小，正确人体解剖，白色背景
